headline: Nagdevi Trading and Investment Company files substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations for Nahar Industrial Enterprises
sum: Nagdevi Trading and Investment Company Ltd has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011 for a substantial acquisition in Nahar Industrial Enterprises Limited. The filing is a mandatory regulatory trigger under takeover rules when a shareholder's holding crosses defined thresholds.
detail: Nagdevi Trading and Investment Company Ltd submitted a takeover disclosure to the NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. The filing indicates a substantial acquisition event in Nahar Industrial Enterprises Limited. Regulation 31(4) requires disclosure within two trading days of acquisition of shares that cross 5% or any multiple thereof. The disclosure is a precursor to potential open offer obligations if the acquirer's stake reaches or exceeds 25% of paid-up capital.
